section.permissions.title: Permissions & approvals
section.permissions.description: Decide what the agent may do right away and what it must ask you about first.
section.about.title: About Cairn
section.about.description: Version, build channel and where your data lives.
about.build.title: Build information
about.build.description: The installer, About page and diagnostics bundle share the same version and build metadata.
about.localData.title: Data & privacy
about.localData.description: Projects, sessions and settings stay on this computer. Diagnostics are redacted before export.
about.legal.title: Notices and compliance
about.legal.description: First-run notice, privacy, GPL source availability and diagnostics export.
permissions.mode.label: Permission mode
permissions.mode.read-only.name: Read-only
permissions.mode.read-only.hint: Can only read files and search
permissions.mode.ask.name: Ask
permissions.mode.ask.hint: Asks before writing files or running commands
permissions.mode.auto.name: Auto
permissions.mode.auto.hint: Follows the rules; still asks for risky actions
permissions.rules.title: Rules
permissions.rules.order: When several rules match, deny wins over ask and ask wins over allow, regardless of order or scope.
permissions.rules.empty: No rules yet. Choose “Always allow” on an approval card, or add one here.
permissions.form.title: Add rule
permissions.form.pathHint: A glob relative to the project folder, such as src/** or **/.env*. Leave empty to match every call of this tool.
permissions.form.commandHint: * matches anything, such as npm test or git status*. Leave empty to match every command.
permissions.form.empty: With “Any tool”, enter a path, or the rule would match every action.
permissions.guard.ask: Whatever the rules say, these always ask again: recursive deletes, git push and force pushes, git reset --hard, privilege elevation, reading or writing sensitive files such as .env and private keys, and writing to .git. An allow rule that names the command can stop the prompt for risky commands like git push; Auto mode does not count.
permissions.guard.deny: Commands that would destroy data outside the workspace or the system (such as deleting the root or home folder, or formatting a disk) are denied outright.
general.sandbox.title: Command sandbox
general.sandbox.description: Controls the OS isolation level for commands run by Agents. The sandbox only covers the process trees started by run_command and start_command; it is not a VM-level security boundary.
general.sandbox.profile.label: Default profile
general.sandbox.profile.read-only.hint: The workspace is not writable; the dedicated temp directory is
The workspace and temp directory are writable; other locations are not
general.sandbox.network.label: Network policy
general.sandbox.network.hintRestricted: The restricted-token mechanism cannot isolate the network; commands can still connect. This option only takes effect with the experimental AppContainer.
general.sandbox.unavailable.label: When the sandbox is unavailable
general.sandbox.unavailable.hint: Fails closed by default. With per-run approval, commands run outside the sandbox only after you confirm each one.
general.sandbox.status.title: Current capability
general.sandbox.status.failed: The sandbox capability could not be read. Export diagnostics for details.
general.sandbox.status.fallback: The selected mechanism {{preferred}} is unavailable; fell back to {{actual}}.
general.sandbox.diagnostics: Capability probe results are included in diagnostics without project content, usernames, or credentials.

diagnostics.title: Export Diagnostic Bundle
diagnostics.description: Review what will be included in the bundle. Credentials, API keys, and home directory paths are redacted.
diagnostics.includeContentHint: Includes message content and tool inputs (may contain code or sensitive text)
diagnostics.items.title: Items Included
diagnostics.items.logsValue: Main log {{main}} lines, host log {{host}} lines

section.update.title: Updates
section.update.description: Review the version, choose an update channel, and restart to install when you are ready.
update.status.title: Version and checks
update.status.description: Updates only download public installers; project content and credentials are never sent to the update source.
update.current.label: Current version
update.channel.label: Update channel
update.channel.hint: Stable receives production releases only; Beta gets new versions earlier.
update.channel.pinnedHint: This build pins the channel, so the selection here has no effect.
update.autoCheck.label: Check for updates automatically
update.autoCheck.hint: Checks in the background at startup and every few hours; it only updates status and never interrupts tasks.
update.lastChecked.label: Last checked
update.detail.upToDate: You are on the latest version.
update.detail.skipped: {{version}} is skipped; checking manually still shows it.
update.detail.downloaded: {{version}} is downloaded and verified. Restart to install.
update.detail.busy: Tasks are still running. Finish or stop them before restarting.
update.detail.installing: Starting the installer. The app will restart shortly…
update.progress.label: Download progress
update.signature.unverified: No publisher signature is configured; this is an unsigned beta. Install only from a source you trust.
update.action.restartBlocked: Tasks are running; restart after they finish
update.source.title: Update source
update.source.description: Installers come from a public read-only HTTPS static source; the client carries no token.
update.source.label: Address
update.source.hint: Checking only requests the version manifest and installer. Network or proxy problems appear above and can be retried.
update.restart.title: Install {{version}} and restart?
update.restart.description: The app backs up the database and settings, then closes and installs the update. Unsaved input will be lost.
update.restart.busy: Tasks are still running. Finish or stop them first; the app never restarts silently during a task.
update.restart.unsigned: This version has no verifiable publisher signature (unsigned beta). Install only from a source you trust.
update.notice.downloadedBusy: {{version}} is downloaded; restart after tasks finish
update.notice.busyHint: Tasks are running; restart after they finish
about.update.title: Updates
about.update.description: The update source is a public read-only static address. Review the current channel and third-party licenses here.
